categoryNames.exotic: Էկզոտիկ քարի և օնիքսի տեսքով թերթեր

products.name: Սև մարմար՝ լայն սպիտակ երակով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սև մարմար՝ լայն սպիտակ երակով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Kitchen-booth right leaf. The top-left corner, left edge and bottom edge are visible, and the inner-trim height is taken as 2.80 m. The horizontal scale comes from the 1.22 m leaf width measured edge to edge in 7671633679050984722 f044, which has the same print (SIFT homography, 110 inliers). There the left edge maps exactly onto the booth leaf's left edge and the right edge maps to x about 690. A pinhole cross-check with f about 520 to 590 px places the right edge at x 650 to 690, about plus or minus 3% on the crop. The quad covers u 0.48 to 0.93 m and v 0.80 to 1.72 m from the sheet's top-left corner. Native density is about 334 to 345 px/m.

products.name: Սպիտակ մարմար՝ մանուշակագույն երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սպիտակ մարմար՝ մանուշակագույն երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: I fitted a panel homography to the front rack leaf's top and bottom trims and its two side edges in this frame. The whole 1.22 x 2.80 m sheet is visible here: about 420 px wide and 950-1060 px tall (the leaf is turned about 11 deg, right side nearer), and that aspect is consistent with the stated size. I chose the quad as panel coordinates u 0.015-1.205 m and v 0.08-1.10 m from the top and projected it back to the frame, so the rectification follows the leaf's perspective. Output is 415x356 px, about 349 px/m on both axes.

products.name: Ձյունաճերմակ մարմար՝ մոխրագույն երանգներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ ձյունաճերմակ մարմար՝ մոխրագույն երանգներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Left wall of the bathroom corner booth, about 40 deg off-axis. The quad follows the perspective: vanishing point about (672,506), from fitted top and bottom trim lines. Vertical scale comes from the 2.80 m sheet height at the corner (709 px). Horizontal scale uses f=470 px. That is a compromise: a 90-deg corner in this booth gives about 420, and the neighbouring booth gives about 620, so the width is within about +-15%. The quad covers u 0.175-0.898 m from the corner and v 0.29-0.99 m from the top.

products.name: Սև մարմար՝ սպիտակ ցանցաձև երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սև մարմար՝ սպիտակ ցանցաձև երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Right wall of the same bathroom booth, about 44 deg off-axis. The quad follows the perspective: vanishing point about (-169,540), from the top trim and the bottom edge, with the model's bottom line checked against the panel's bottom edge. Vertical scale comes from the 2.80 m sheet height at the corner (699 px). Horizontal scale uses the same f=470 px compromise; f from 420 to 620 gives 0.55-0.69 m, so the width uncertainty is about -5% to +17%. The quad covers u 0.40-0.985 m from the corner and v 2.12-2.74 m from the top.

products.name: Սալորագույն-սև մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն եզրերով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սալորագույն-սև մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն եզրերով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The flip-display leaf is about 190x850 px and is turned about 10 deg (VP far left), so it is close to front-facing. I assumed the leaf is about 0.61 m wide (half of a 1.22 m sheet). That gives about 311 px/m and a leaf about 2.7 m tall, which is consistent with the camera height and presenter checks. The quad covers 0.95 of the leaf width (180 px = 0.58 m) and 362 px of height. Horizontal and vertical px/m agree to about 1%.

products.name: Սպիտակ-յասամանագույն մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն եզրագծերով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սպիտակ-յասամանագույն մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն եզրագծերով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The whole right-hand portal panel is visible at t=10.8s (about 140x765 px, front-facing, level camera). Taking the visible height as about 2.85 m (2.9 m sheet) gives about 268 px/m and a panel about 0.52 m wide. Camera-height and floor-line checks rule out a much shorter panel. SIFT scale from t=10.8s to t=12.5s is 1.43, so about 384 px/m in the source frame. The quad is 167x487 px, which gives 0.435 x 1.27 m. Front-facing (horizontal bottom edge), so pixel aspect is kept.

products.name: Կրեմագույն մարմար՝ պղնձագույն երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ կրեմագույն մարմար՝ պղնձագույն երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: This is a swinging flip-display leaf, captured at its widest and most still moment. Its bottom edge (366,916)-(542,945) and the near-level camera give a horizontal vanishing point near x=-2000, so the leaf is turned about 17 deg. I modelled the plane with f between 650 and 850 px; the size changes by under 3% across that range. I assumed the leaf is about 0.61 m wide, the same as the other leaves (about 180 px at mid-height). The quad then measures 0.335 m wide by 1.27 m tall.

products.name: Սև մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն հոսող նախշով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սև մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն հոսող նախշով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The panel is a swing leaf in the chrome flip-book rack. I solved the perspective from the leaf's four frame corners at t=24.0 s (visible part H/W 5.65, tilt about 11 deg) and carried it to the sharper, closer t=23.6 frame with a SIFT homography (247 inliers). The vertical scale comes from a leaf print height of about 2.65 m, based on the horizon from the leaf-edge vanishing point and on the presenter's eye level and height (range 2.55-2.8 m). Across the leaves, this gives widths of about 0.56-0.63 m, which fits half-width 0.61 m display leaves. Expected error is about ±10%.

products.name: Սպիտակ մարմար՝ վառ ոսկեգույն երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սպիտակ մարմար՝ վառ ոսկեգույն երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Leaf at its most frontal, with all four frame corners visible (H/W 4.2, tilt about 17 deg). This gave the homography, and the sub-rectangle was taken in leaf coordinates. The scale comes from the same leaf height of about 2.65 m as the other leaves, so this visible leaf is about 0.63 m wide. Expected error is about ±10%.

products.name: Մուգ յասամանագույն մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ մուգ յասամանագույն մարմար՝ ոսկեգույն երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Leaf frame corners at t=32.53 s (visible H/W about 5.0; the right side is cut off by a chrome post in front, which moves between frames). Perspective is solved from those corners, and the scale uses the shared leaf height of about 2.65 m. Expected error is about ±10%.

products.name: Բաց մոխրագույն մարմար՝ ամպանման երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ բաց մոխրագույն մարմար՝ ամպանման երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: I measured the whole sheet as a quad: TL 6.5,156, TR 258.7,36.1, BR 276.5,926.6, BL 4,836.7. BR comes from where the right-edge and bottom-edge lines cross. I mapped the quad to the stated 1.22 x 2.90 m. That size fits a focal length of about 445 px, close to the 492 px given by the orthogonality check. The output quad covers u 0.68-1.18 m and v 0.08-1.00 m in sheet coordinates, so the scale and proportions come straight from the rectified sheet.

products.name: Մոխրաբեժ մարմար՝ շերտավոր երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ մոխրաբեժ մարմար՝ շերտավոր երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The leaf of the rotating rack is turned about 12-15 degrees. I measured its bottom and side edges in this view and transferred its top edge from t=47.0 s with a SIFT homography on the veins (241 inliers). With f about 460 px, taken from the light-grey sheet, the leaf face is W/H = 0.25. Taking the visible leaf height as 2.88 m gives a face about 0.72 m wide. The quad covers u 0.215-0.695 m and v 2.17-2.83 m in leaf coordinates. As a cross-check, the charcoal leaf in the same rack reads about 0.77 m wide.

products.name: Մուգ մոխրագույն մարմար՝ սպիտակ երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ մուգ մոխրագույն մարմար՝ սպիտակ երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: In frame 053 the leaf faces the camera almost straight on, with equal left and right edge heights. The visible face there measures W/H = 0.268, and that ratio holds for any focal length from 300 to 900 px. I took the visible height as 2.88 m (2.90 m sheet), which makes the visible face about 0.77 m wide; its left part is hidden by the neighbouring leaf. I mapped the leaf corners into t=52.9 s with a SIFT homography on the veins, using a mask that leaves out the reflections. The quad covers u 0.10-0.745 m and v 0.565-1.315 m. Scaling from the presenter's height gives a leaf height of 2.7-2.8 m, within 5% of this.

products.name: Սպիտակ մարմար՝ նուրբ մոխրագույն երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ սպիտակ մարմար՝ նուրբ մոխրագույն երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The camera is close and front-facing. The leaf's own label (XL8236-1) is 43x55 px, w/h 0.78 against a frontal 0.76. Using the same label size as above (0.078 x 0.103 m, from a leaf face of about 2.75 m), that is about 545 px/m at the label. Below the label the scale grows with camera pitch, measured from the diverging trims. Integrated over the quad, the result is 0.13 m wide (both the top and bottom edges give about 0.128-0.133 m) and about 0.575 m tall (0.56-0.62 m depending on the pitch estimate).

products.name: Ավազագույն քար՝ մեղմ երակներով
products.alt: Մարմարի տեսքով թերթ՝ ավազագույն քար՝ մեղմ երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The leaf's own price label is 31x40 px, giving a w/h of 0.76. That matches the frontal reference from the pulled-out leaves at t=47.9 and 52.6 s, so the strip is front-facing. The label size, 0.078 x 0.103 m, comes from the leaf face height: about 2.75 m equals 26.7 label heights, measured at t=49.5 and 52.6 s. That gives about 395 px/m on both axes. The 56 x 497 px quad is therefore 0.14 x 1.26 m.

products.name: Բեժ քարացած փայտ՝ սև երակներով
products.alt: Քարի տեսքով թերթ՝ բեժ քարացած փայտ՝ սև երակներով, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Full sheet geometry measured in 7674283683913813266 frame 023, where the left edge and the top and bottom trim lines are visible. Inner-trim height is taken as 2.80 m. The horizontal scale comes from the vanishing points of both corner-booth leaves, assuming a 90-degree corner (f about 633 px). The leaf's 0 to 1.12 m spans x 258 to 550 in that frame, and the result changes by less than 5% for f between 550 and 710. The frame was transferred to the sharper 7675 frame with a SIFT homography (about 60 inliers). The quad covers u 0.03 to 0.58 m and v 0.03 to 1.04 m from the sheet's top-left corner. Native density is about 270 px/m horizontally and 297 px/m vertically.

products.name: Մանուշակագույն սոդալիտ
products.alt: Քարի տեսքով թերթ՝ մանուշակագույն սոդալիտ, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Bedroom-booth left leaf. In the t=4.0s frame the top and bottom trim lines of both booth leaves are visible, and their vanishing points with a 90-degree corner give f about 650 px (620 was used). The inner-trim height is taken as 2.80 m at the corner edge (694 px, or 248 px/m). About 0.97 m of the leaf's width, measured from the corner, is visible. The geometry was transferred to the sharper t=5.13s frame by a SIFT homography (about 500 inliers). The quad spans 0.68 m wide, ending 0.09 m left of the corner trim, and 1.28 m tall from 0.12 m below the top trim. Native density is about 280 to 297 px/m.

products.name: Շագանակագույն բրածո քար
products.alt: Քարի տեսքով թերթ՝ շագանակագույն բրածո քար, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Right wall of the bedroom corner booth, turned about 46 deg. The quad follows the wall's perspective: horizontal vanishing point about (-382,517), taken from the top trim and the bottom edge. Vertical scale comes from the 2.80 m sheet height at the corner (788 px). Horizontal scale comes from a level-camera model with f about 649 px, which assumes the booth corner is 90 deg (both walls' vanishing points). The quad covers u 0.03-0.63 m from the corner and v 0.10-1.05 m from the top. With f about 590-630 the width changes by 0 to -4%; with f about 420 it would be about 15% narrower.

products.name: Սպիտակ ժայռաքար, մեծ թերթ
products.alt: Քարի ռելիեֆով վահանակ՝ սպիտակ ժայռաքար, մեծ թերթ, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The rock is on the corridor wall at a steep angle, so the quad is a true wall-plane rectangle. Corridor vanishing point (574,482): the ceiling junction, the ceiling-channel edge and the rock's floor junction all meet within 1 px in 1fps frame 16. Vertical vanishing point comes from the fluted-panel and column edges. Focal length is about 420 px (0.5x ultra-wide). The beam, soffit and track cross-lines give about 420-560 px, and the 0.5x lens prior gives 370-410 px. The principal point was solved for orthogonality. Vertical scale: in frame 16, rock floor junction to ceiling line = 2.80 m (sheet length). This scale was carried to t=15.87 s and then to t=22.87 s by SIFT plane homographies (153 and 311 inliers, 0.7 px mean error). Horizontal and vertical distances agree within 2.5% between frames. Result: 0.284 x 0.630 m. f=370-480 px gives a width of 0.25-0.30 m (within about ±10%); the height does not depend on f. Cross-check: the slat sample strips beside the rock come out at about 0.26 m with about 10 slats, a plausible pitch of about 2.6 cm.

products.name: Ռեյկային՝ բաց մոխրագույն
products.alt: Ռեյկային վահանակ՝ ռեյկային՝ բաց մոխրագույն, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: I counted 15 slats per panel on this wall: the grey and walnut panels at full width in the 13-25 s shots. The panel has to be about 0.60 m wide: in wide frame 15, a vanishing-point rectification gives a height/width ratio of about 4.5, so a 1.22 m panel would be 5.5 m tall. That puts the slat pitch at 40 mm (slat about 27 mm plus a 13 mm groove), a standard acoustic-slat spec. The quad runs groove-centre to groove-centre across 14 pitches, so it is 0.56 m wide and tiles horizontally without a seam. For the vertical scale I used the local horizontal px/m (15.4 px pitch, so 385 px/m) with a correction of about 1.04 for the wall turning about 13 degrees (horizontal vanishing point at x of about -3350 px, from the pitch gradient). That gives 401 px/m, so the quad's mean height of 281 px is 0.70 m. Top and bottom edges are sloped toward that vanishing point. In the output, the grooves are exactly 16.0 px apart and vertical. moduleH 2.80 is an estimate: the panels run floor to ceiling and the frame-15 aspect gives 2.4-2.8 m.

products.name: Ռեյկային՝ տաք ընկուզենի
products.alt: Ռեյկային վահանակ՝ ռեյկային՝ տաք ընկուզենի, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: In frame 15 the whole walnut panel is visible and has 15 slats, so it is about a 0.60 m panel with a 40 mm pitch, the same as the grey panel next to it. The quad spans 11 pitches: from a half-groove before slat 1, at the edge of the black band between panels, to the groove between slats 11 and 12. That makes it 0.44 m wide and seamless horizontally. The local pitch is 17.4 px (436 px/m), with a perspective correction of about 0.98 because this panel is almost front-facing to its viewing ray. That gives 426 px/m vertically, so the mean quad height of 358 px is 0.84 m. Top and bottom edges are sloped toward the horizontal vanishing point. In the output, the grooves are evenly spaced at 17.4 px and vertical. moduleH 2.80 is estimated: floor to ceiling, 2.4-2.8 m from frame 15.

products.name: Ռեյկային՝ մուգ սուրճագույն
products.alt: Ռեյկային վահանակ՝ ռեյկային՝ մուգ սուրճագույն, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Horizontal: the slat pitch here is 14 px. Each neighbouring panel section (grey, warm walnut) covers about 15 pitches, which gives the standard 0.6 m acoustic panel and a 4.0 cm slat-plus-groove pitch. The quad spans 5.25 pitches, so 0.21 m. Vertical: the panel runs about 910 px top to bottom at this x; taking that as 2.8 m gives about 326 px/m. This agrees with the horizontal ppm after correcting for the wall's perspective (ratio about 1.07). Output pitch is 14.1 px, about 3.95 cm.

products.name: Ակոսավոր՝ գրաֆիտ
products.alt: Ռեյկային վահանակ՝ ակոսավոր՝ գրաֆիտ, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The sample leans on the back wall and is seen about 30 degrees off-axis. Its top and bottom edges converge to a vanishing point near x=-750 to -800, and its verticals stay parallel. The camera model gives a horizontal-to-vertical foreshortening of about 0.72 (0.71-0.76 for f 550-740 px). With the panel 2.8 m tall (its left edge spans about 535 px), that gives about 4.2 cm per flute. Cross-checks agree: the adjacent silver panel's 3.9 cm pitch, corrected for depth and foreshortening, gives about 3.9 cm, and 14 flutes across a 0.6 m panel gives about 4.3 cm. The quad runs groove to groove over 12 pitches (0.504 m). Its height is local vertical px x 0.72 / horizontal px, scaled to that width. moduleW 0.60 is an estimate: the panel shows 14 flutes edge to edge, about 0.59 m.

products.name: Ռեյկային՝ արծաթամոխրագույն
products.alt: Ռեյկային վահանակ՝ ռեյկային՝ արծաթամոխրագույն, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: The sample leans on the wall and faces the camera almost head-on. Its horizontal vanishing point is far away (about x=-5500), and the panel spans y 165 to 772. The slat pitch grows from 8.0 px at the top to 9.1 px at the bottom because of the lean. Integrated over the full height that is about 72 pitch units, so a 2.8 m panel gives about 3.9 cm per slat plus groove, which is plausible. The quad runs groove to groove over 9 pitches (0.351 m). Its height is 218 px at a local 8.25 px pitch, or 26.5 pitch units, so 1.033 m. The lean's vertical compression is offset by the camera looking up at this region, a net error of about 1%. moduleW 0.60 is an estimate: the right edge is hidden by the rack frame, at least 11.5 slats (about 0.45 m) are visible, and 15 slats of about 4 cm would match the neighbouring fluted sample.

products.name: Մեղրագույն կաղնի
products.alt: Վահանակ՝ մեղրագույն կաղնի, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: At t=4.4 s the whole sheet height is visible and near front-facing: 822 px between the frame trims, taken as 2.80 m, so about 294 px/m. At t=7.87 s the camera is closer, and the two label stickers measure about 1.35x larger, so about 397 px/m. The quad is 183x477 px, so 0.46 x 1.20 m. The verticals lean about 2.3 deg (camera roll), and the quad follows that lean.

products.name: Ոսկեգույն թիք
products.alt: Վահանակ՝ ոսկեգույն թիք, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Calibrated on the same video. Frame 1 and frame 22.4s show the ceiling trims and floor lines of the corner bays. Assuming a 90 deg corner, both views give the same focal length, about 461 px, and a wall height of 2.80 m from trim to floor. The right (teak) wall at 10.03s is about 50 deg to the view axis, from the ceiling-trim slope near the corner, with the horizon near the frame centre (wood streaks stay vertical, so there is almost no pitch). The corner is about 1.6 m from the camera, from the ceiling-trim height and the column width (42.5 px against 41-43.5 px in the calibrated frames). The quad was built as a true rectangle in wall coordinates, 0.60 m wide (about half the 1.22 m sheet) x 1.02 m tall, then projected into the frame. Its aspect ratio hardly depends on the angle (about 5% across 46-54 deg).

products.name: Բնական բաց կաղնի
products.alt: Վահանակ՝ բնական բաց կաղնի, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Same 90 deg corner-bay calibration (f about 461 px). The oak bay's own ceiling trims and floor lines at 22.4s fix the left wall at about 35 deg to the view axis (vanishing point x about 610), the horizon at about 493 px, and the corner depth at 1.75 m (737 px for a 2.80 m wall). 24.0s is a sharper, closer moment from the same camera movement: the column is 57 px wide against 43.5 px, so the corner is about 1.34 m away, and the camera orientation stays stable (the wall angle is 34.5-35.9 deg in every frame where it can be measured). The quad is a wall rectangle, 0.39 m wide x 0.87 m tall, projected into the frame.

products.name: Բաց կրեմագույն տրավերտին
products.alt: Վահանակ՝ բաց կրեմագույն տրավերտին, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: I measured all four inner edges of the sheet in the t=10.4s frame: TL (168,128), TR (490.5,-9.3), BR (541.5,948), BL (177,846). I assumed a 1.22 x 2.80 m sheet and built a homography from those corners. I then chose a metric rectangle on the sheet (x 0.03-1.18 m, y 0.08-1.08 m from the sheet top) and projected it back to get the quad '174.3,144.4 478.0,20.8 494.2,337.0 177.6,389.6'. That makes it 1.15 x 1.00 m, and the quad follows the sheet's strong keystone and turn exactly. If the sheet is 2.90 m tall, the height would be about 1.04 m, which is within tolerance.

products.name: Մոկա
products.alt: Միագույն վահանակ՝ մոկա, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Corner booth geometry. In the wide shots (frame 1 and t=19.7s) the ceiling and floor lines give the wall vanishing points and f of about 510 px, assuming a 90-degree corner. Corner wall height is about 755 px for an assumed 2.8 m sheet, so the black-trimmed corner LED profile is about 0.153 m wide. At t=15.40s the profile is 58.5 px, so the corner scale is about 382 px/m, and equal trim widths show the walls at about 45 degrees. The quad's top and bottom edges follow the wall's horizontal lines toward the vanishing point near x 820. The size was solved from a wall-plane model with f about 600 (510-720 bracket, within roughly ±8%).

products.name: Ավազագույն
products.alt: Միագույն վահանակ՝ ավազագույն, NEW DEC
products.scaleBasis: Same corner-booth model as the mocha sheet. At t=24.50s the corner LED profile (about 0.153 m, calibrated against the 2.8 m wall height in the wide t=19.7s shot) is 50 px, so the corner scale is about 327 px/m. Equal trim widths show the walls at about 45 degrees, so the right wall recedes to a vanishing point near x -380 (f about 600, 510-720 bracket). The quad's top edge slopes with the wall's horizontal lines and the size was solved from the wall-plane model. ±10%.

products.scaleBasis: The sheet is a very oblique left wing, about 26 deg from the view axis. The horizontal vanishing point (531.6, 517.7) comes from the fitted top and bottom trim lines, and the vertical direction from the far edge trim. The camera focal length (about 500 px, a wide lens) was solved from the adjacent travertine sheet, taken as 1.22 x 2.80 m. Two independent constraints agreed on 470-525 px. The sheet height between trims at the far edge is taken as 2.80 m. The plane model then gives 0.39 x 0.81 m for the quad; the width is about +-10% for focal lengths of 460-540 px.

gaps.name: Սպիտակ մարմար՝ սև երակներով
gaps.reason: Only a sliver is ever visible. In the sliding-leaf rack this leaf (NV-B5) is always overlapped by its neighbours and is never pulled out. Its lit face is only 40-46 px wide (about 0.11-0.12 m of the sheet) in every moment checked: front views at 33-35.7 s and 38-39 s, side views at 36-37.6 s, and 48.3-50 s. At 39-47 s inset photos also cover the lower part. A strip this narrow cannot show the sparse, bold black-vein layout of a 1.22 m sheet. Tiling it would turn the sparse veins into a dense repeat. A clearer source is needed, such as a front-facing shot of this sheet or a showroom photo.

gaps.reason: The light oak panel only appears as a wedge-shaped sliver at the left edge of the frame in 7684313597001927953. I checked 30fps extracts from 13.9 s to 20 s, and the camera never pans further left. At its widest the sliver is about 60 px at the top of the wall, narrowing to about 25 px near the floor. The slats lean about 4 degrees, so a quad that follows them and stays on the panel is only about 30-48 px wide (3-4 slats). It also has a strong spotlight gradient and on-screen text crosses its lower part. The other source, 7680190853645716756 frame 9, is a background strip about 28 px wide that includes a label, and its match to this product is low-confidence. Under the 60 px limit, so I did not make a texture.

gaps.name: Ռեյկային՝ մոխրաշագանակագույն
gaps.reason: No usable clean area. Across the whole video (checked 1fps frames 1-28 and 10/30fps extracts) this strip is only seen at a grazing angle in the corridor sample row. At its widest it is about 36 px (t=22.87 s, x 353-388) and about 32 px at t=1.5 s, well under the 60 px threshold. Its ~10 slats are only about 3.5 px each in the image, and the lower part is behind the presenter's hair or white label stickers. It is also ambiguous: it may be the smoked or warm walnut slat under corridor light. Geometry for a future source: the sample strips in this row (dark brown, light grey, taupe) have equal widths of about 0.26 m (±10%) with about 10 slats, so the pitch is about 2.6 cm.

gaps.name: Ռեյկային՝ ժանգագույն թիք
gaps.reason: No usable clean area. Its widest appearance in the video is a sliver of about 30-45 px (t=22.87 s around x 389-425; t=1.5 s around x 397-442), under the 60 px threshold, at a grazing angle. Slats are barely resolved (about 4 px pitch, low contrast). The face has a strong lighting gradient: near-black brown at the top and a saturated orange spotlight glow lower down. White product-label stickers sit at its lower end, with the grey glass panel immediately to the right. The identity is also ambiguous: it may be the warm-walnut acoustic slat under warm spotlighting. It measures about 15-20% wider than the neighbouring 0.26 m strips (about 0.30 m).

gaps.name: Ակոսավոր՝ սպիտակ, լայն ակոսներով
gaps.reason: In every moment of video 7687641327487438100 (I checked all 28 s at 5 fps, plus extra frames at 0.1 s steps from t=1.2 to 1.8), the white fluted panel shows only as a nearly edge-on strip about 40-46 px wide, well under the ~60 px limit. Row profiles put the visible face at about x 203-245 (t 1.4 s, y 120-280), about x 211-253 at y 430, and about x 174-220 at t 20 s, y 150. The panel is the first sample on the corridor side wall, and its top edge follows the ceiling's vanishing slope, so it is seen about 80+ degrees off-normal. Flattening it would stretch about 5 flute periods (about 8 px each) roughly 8-10x horizontally, and the flute shading at that grazing angle is mostly the self-occluded sides of the half-rounds, not the frontal profile. The real width of what is visible cannot be measured: the sheet width and flute count are unknown, and the rock sheet may hide its left edge. Any metre scale would be a guess. There are also obstructions. The presenter's hair, hand and arm cover the lower half (y > ~350-450) in every frame. Armenian caption text crosses y ~230-290 from t 2 s, and dimension call-out labels sit at y ~200-215 around t 17-21 s. Frame 26 (listed as a source) is even more oblique, at about 30-40 px. No other video shows this product. The 'fluted-panel-colour-range' in 7680190853645716756 is a different, fine-ribbed product. Result: no usable clean area, and no texture was generated.
